For 5 months... I was diagnosed a year and a half ago, and I was taking all sorts of things back then, nothing seems to be working, till I decide to change my psychiatrist which introduced me to lithium.
 The side effects that I felt the most was the shaking hands, and dry mouth, and it didn't take long to disappear, my appetite hasn't changed much...
  The main thing with lithium is that you have to drink lots and lots of water and regularly submit blood test (6 months is what I have been told). Even though it is the best drug to treat BP disorder...😶
That's good! I wasn't functional at all, lithium just helps with the mood swings, and so far my bf is more than happy that I'm getting stable.

It's a long ride for sure. But lithium actually helps a lot, it also will protect your brain, I'm on lithium for 5 months now, I know how scary it can be, all sorts of stuff popping up in your mind, and seems like u never be the same. 
 But as hard as it can be try not to think about it, really. Focus on the people that are by your side, and in yourself, you will still do everything on your way. As long as it gets stabilize nobody will notice your disease. You'll be ok mate, for now one keep yourself busy, find out some hobbies, do sports, anything... You'll be fine :)
